name: Dental Cosmetic Center of North Brunswick
what_they_do: General and cosmetic dental office at 1648 US Highway 130 (suite 5 per insurance directories), open Mon/Wed/Thu 9-5 and Sat 8-2, closed Tue and Fri. Services are documented only through third-party directories and its Google listing - the practice has no website of its own. Listed in AmeriHealth Medicare and Aetna Better Health provider directories, so it appears to accept insured and plan-referred patients.
customers: Local North Brunswick patients and plan-referred patients (Medicare/Dental directory listings suggest a meaningful share of insurance-driven, older or Medicaid/Medicare-adjacent patients).

size_signals.signal: Unclaimed Birdeye profile with 100 reviews and a 4.8 average, i.e. an established but under-marketed practice
Listed with phone (732) 821-8183 at 1648 U.S. Highway 130, Suite 5 in an AmeriHealth Medicare dental directory
Part-time schedule (closed Tuesday and Friday) suggests a small office rather than a multi-doctor group (inference from posted hours)

listing.reviews: Google count not displayed in the limited view; a third-party profile shows 100 reviews at 4.8

website_review.online_booking_or_quote: None. No website, no booking link on the Google profile (it shows 'Add website'), no claimed directories.
website_review.trust_signals: None under the practice's own control; the only proof points are third-party reviews (4.8-4.9 stars) and insurance directory listings
website_review.out_of_date_signs: No site to be out of date; the Google profile is missing a website field and the Birdeye profile is explicitly unclaimed
website_review.search_basics: No owned pages at all, so no title/description, no service pages, no hours as text outside directories
top_issues: No website in 2026 for a practice with ~100 reviews and strong ratings
Google profile has no website link and hours/services depend on third parties
No booking path except phoning (732) 821-8183 during a 4-day week

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: a Google profile exists with dentist category, hours ('Closed - Opens 8 AM Sat') and phone, and the practice is marked LGBTQ+ friendly, but the profile literally prompts 'Add website' and there is no owned domain to crawl - nor any robots.txt to check because there is no site. Answerable: hours are visible on Google and on an unclaimed Birdeye page, but nothing states services, service area or price ranges in the practice's own words. Bookable: zero - no site, no form, no scheduler; a patient's agent can only place a phone call.

operations_signals.signal: Only contact channel is a phone line during a four-day week (closed Tue and Fri) - inference: missed calls go unanswered
Insurance directory participation (AmeriHealth Medicare, Aetna Better Health) implies eligibility checks and plan-specific billing at the front desk
Birdeye profile is unclaimed, so review responses and appointment requests through that channel are unmanaged

top_opportunities.opportunity: Build a simple, fast practice site: what they do, hours, service list, insurance accepted, click-to-call and a booking/request form - the practice currently has zero owned web presence
top_opportunities.evidence: Google profile shows 'Add website'; no domain found for the practice in any search

top_opportunities.opportunity: Claim and complete the Google Business Profile and the unclaimed Birdeye profile (website, services, photos, insurance), then answer reviews - both are currently owned by third parties
top_opportunities.evidence: Birdeye page states 'This profile has not been claimed by the business owner'; Google offers 'Add missing information'

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add an online booking/request path plus an after-hours answering agent, since the office is closed three days a week and phone is the only intake
top_opportunities.evidence: Hours show closed Tue/Fri plus closed evenings; no form or scheduler anywhere

scores.reasons: Gap: no website, unclaimed profiles, phone-only - nearly everything is missing. Pay: established 100-review practice but a part-time four-day schedule and insurance-heavy mix suggest modest, not large, budget. Ease: a new site plus booking is a multi-week build rather than a tweak. Evidence: Google profile, unclaimed Birdeye profile and insurance directory listings seen, but nothing first-party because there is no site.
